warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).
Widths: where two widths are printed (1.00/0.90, 0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Door heights 2.05 to ระดับพื้นห้อง.

น1/น2/น3 print sill 0.85 + window 1.10 against an overall 2.05 (adds to 1.95), and น4 prints sill 1.65 + window 0.40 against 2.15 (adds to 2.05) — kept the printed values, flagged; head_height_m = the printed overall.
